method.simulation: One 1/60 second game/audio update per rendered frame; native terrain clock remains wall time; vsync0, normal1ms loop sleep
method.cpu: Separate CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID main thread and os.clock process CPU; process includes workers, wall includes native waits; no displayed FPS or GPU timestamp claim
method.summary: Median of two per-trial map-averages at each actual pixel size, not a pooled percentile or robust many-trial distribution
method.construction: Both RNGs seeded, sorted neighbor construction and fresh test NPC pool; native actor updates/draws unchanged; canonical signatures include identities/sprites/coordinates/timers/ghost offsets
method.allocationProbes: After all timed phases and OS proofs only

presenterMethodControl.method: Same captured1920x1440RGBA actual FireRed frame, same process AB/BA,30warmup+300calls/block,automaticGC, type setup outside timing; no game draw/update/readback during blocks; source byte-for-byte unchanged afterwards, not gameplay throughput

preliminaryPilot.reason: Exploratory AB pair before allocation-failure hardening, kept separate from final-source primary trials

limits: One non-dedicated host with external load uncontrolled.
Two pairs per game and short stationary native flat-world scenes do not establish all-gameplay or FPS acceptance.
Metal window/GPU correctness is checked; no Metal performance comparison or ordinary Metal code change.
No fresh LOVE11.5, other hardware, fullscreen/context-loss/long-duration/First-Third/Origami acceptance.
Synchronous GPU readback, vImage shuffle and immutable CF image copying remain costs.
